member.name: T:Parbad.Storage.Abstractions.IPaidPaymentLookup
member.summary:
An optional capability of an : finding a paid payment by the transaction code the bank reported for it.
A storage that implements this lets Parbad reject a verification whose bank transaction already settled another invoice, which is what prevents one payment from settling two orders. Storages that do not implement it keep working; Parbad then logs that the check was skipped.

member.name: T:Parbad.Storage.Abstractions.IPaymentCompletion
member.summary:
An optional capability of an : completing a payment in one atomic step, only if no other operation completed it in a way that must be kept.
Two verifications of the same payment can run at the same time, e.g. after a double click, a refreshed callback page, a bank that retries the callback, or with several servers. A storage that implements this lets Parbad make sure the slower one cannot overwrite the result of the faster one. Storages that do not implement it keep working; Parbad then writes the result without this guard and logs that.
